name: Sakuraba Shuuya
source:
2nd year high school student.
A moody returnee, he studied overseas in middle school and only recently came back to Japan alone.
His hobby is music. He doesn't have much interest in anything besides his guitar.
He's considered cold by those around him, but he's not acting that way intentionally.
